election_identity.verification: The official Alabama Votes election-night page labels ecode=1001305 as 2026 GENERAL ELECTION and presents statewide Governor and United States Senator contests. The ecode is observed on the live page; it is not inferred.

provider_family: Alabama Secretary of State / Alabama Votes electionNight ASP.NET Web Forms site (official; server-rendered HTML, export action present but machine-readable format not verified)

endpoints.export_action: Statewide page includes an Export Data link invoking ASP.NET postback hlnkExportData. It requires form state; resulting file format/body has not been verified.

source.official_disclaimer: Results are unofficial and presented as a courtesy of the Alabama Secretary of State and Probate Judges; accuracy is the responsibility of each reporting county's Probate Judge.
source.page_metadata: Live HTML contains statewide election title, total ballots, registered voters, turnout, counties reported, and last-updated timestamp. County HTML contains county name, ballots, registered voters, turnout, boxes reported, timestamp, and contest candidates/counts.

fetches.result: Retrieved 112440-byte HTML. Observed current HTML metadata: 2026 GENERAL ELECTION; 66 counties reported at 11/03/2026 10:26:54 PM; statewide totals and contest rows embedded in HTML. For Governor: Doug Jones 713,359, Tommy Tuberville 807,653, write-in 5,365. For U.S. Senator: Everett Wess 671,111, Barry Moore 848,047, write-in 1,736. Values are live snapshot counts and will change.
Retrieved county index HTML containing county links and observed county IDs. County result links follow countyResultsByContest.aspx?cid={id}&ecode=1001305.

Live county HTML identifies cid=01 as Jefferson County, reports 103623 ballots, 497469 registered voters, 20.83% turnout, boxes reported 53.93%, last updated 11/03/2026 09:43:04 PM. Governor and U.S. Senate contests are present; Governor Doug Jones 83076 votes in this snapshot.

county_coverage.note: Official county index exposes county result links across 67 county entries. Statewide live page reports 66 counties reporting in the fetched snapshot. Other counties may have zero/unreported totals; per-county fetch coverage was not exhaustively enumerated.

license.status: No explicit reuse license located for election-night HTML/export in this investigation.
license.terms: Site labels figures unofficial and attributes submissions to Alabama's Probate Judges; public accessibility alone does not establish a separate redistribution license.

limitations: The live source is public, official server-rendered HTML. Although an Export Data control exists, the output was not retrieved; no CSV/XML/JSON feed is claimed.
Counts and timestamps are transient snapshots. Fetch time was not logged precisely, and numbers may have advanced since retrieval.
County index and one county page were directly inspected; all 67 individual county pages were not fetched.
County results are explicitly unofficial and county probate judges are responsible for reported accuracy.

preferred_verified_source.provider: Reported election returns via The New York Times
preferred_verified_source.message: 67 counties with published returns. Source times apply to the published race feed; individual local update times are not supplied. Unofficial counts; no forecast or expected-vote estimates are included.
